decisions.decision: Area-average reduced images despite §10.7.4's point-sample/no-area-average text.
decisions.reconsideration: This is an explicit product-policy departure; §10.7.1's NOTE says algorithm details are not defined but does not expressly waive the image sentence. Retain the ledger's departed status and risk record; this shard does not revisit its necessity or image fixtures.

decisions.decision: Use explicit area coverage arithmetic for a closed-form edge case.
decisions.reconsideration: The parent §10.7.4 row and this clause's source language distinguish measured coverage from the literal whole-intersecting-pixel result. Keep as departed/qualified evidence; no behavior change or retest proposed.

decisions.decision: Interpret a partly covered pixel by its covered area in anti-aliased rendering.
decisions.reconsideration: §10.7.4's intersecting-pixel and minimum painted-area rules are explicit; §10.7.1's algorithm NOTE alone is not a clear normative exception. ADR 1560 acknowledges that these are departures, which should remain visible. No clause-wide conformance claim follows from precise area computation.

decisions.decision: Record departures from §10.7.4 instead of treating the general algorithm NOTE as blanket permission.
decisions.reconsideration: This is the strongest source-aligned framing among the sampled records. Keep its distinction between explicit rules and implementation choice. The parent ledger's §10.7.4 status already says departed; parent family prose also contains older wording that says §10.7.1 'licenses the departures', which conflicts with §10.7.4's note that the NOTE licenses none. Reconcile that wording.
decisions.status: retain; family ledger prose needs reconciliation

decisions.decision: Treat zero-area collapsed marks as points/bands under the selected §10.7.4 reading.
decisions.reconsideration: Read only as existing bounded implementation evidence; B20/B19 are excluded here. The cited point/line fixtures make the chosen pixel result explicit. No new certification of every collapsed geometry is made.

decisions.decision: Turn on the axis-aligned thin-stroke grid fit under SA=true in all backends after owner answer A714, and mark §10.7.5 implemented.
decisions.reconsideration: Current source's first requirement is not syntactically restricted to thin axis-aligned rules, whereas the selected implementation is. A714 is explicit authorization for this construction and explains its tradeoff; it does not amend ISO text. Keep the decision as owner policy, state the precise supported set, and retain a residual question whether the unqualified ledger status overstates conformance for unsupported path families.
decisions.status: owner choice implemented; normative breadth residual

decisions.decision: Use tighter of fixed and extent-relative flattening bounds.
decisions.reconsideration: §10.7.2 explicitly permits ignoring file FL, allowing a device-selected internal curve tolerance. The relative bound is an implementation choice, not a document-level FL promise. No issue found in sampled source alignment.

decisions.decision: Resolve stroke width per placement at encode and carry SA to raster backends.
decisions.reconsideration: This is the placement architecture, not a scan-adjustment algorithm. Current tests show the choice is integrated into three actual lanes. The remaining normative question belongs to ADR 2530/2553's restricted fit behavior.
